recap_format_guide.content: Monthly recap format: 1) Headline win rate and totals; 2) Closed Won list with account, amount, rep; 3) Closed Lost list with account, amount, loss reason; 4) MoM comparison vs prior month; 5) Rep leaderboard by won amount. Values must be preserved verbatim from source records.
